title: 抽象液体排版文字
prompt: Abstract liquid typography spelling "text", made of thick, transparent water-gel with realistic refraction and soft shadows. Each letter appears sculpted from droplets with surface tension, smooth curves, and light reflections. Water droplets scattered on the surface, minimal background, hyper-realistic lighting, photorealistic render
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，打造超现实的抽象液体排版文字，适用于摄影与品牌设计，呈现透明水凝胶字母的逼真折射和柔和光影，为数字艺术注入现代简约美学。
